name: B10-0558/2025 – Recital E – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the European citizens’ initiative entitled ‘My Voice, My Choice: For Safe and Accessible Abortion’
part_text: E.whereas women’s ability to exercise their reproductive autonomy, including their right to decide freely and responsibly whether, when and how to get pregnant and have children, must be guaranteed; whereas scientific literacy is essential to understand the biological processes of pregnancy to allow each individual to understand when and how fertilisation can occur;
